lines: First, you need the strength
of someone fit to rule the seas.
Without it, the Proof will never
reveal itself to you.
So you mean a big fleet?
Or do you mean becoming
a capable sailor?
You've all got your own ideas.
Maybe it takes all of those things.
Wow... That's a lot to take on.
I'd start with the major cities
in each region. Check nearby, too.
Come on, come on. You'll see
when we get there.
Rafael, what do you think
of sailors?
WWWWWWWWWWWWWWWW, what do you think
of sailors?
Janus! Clau! Keep fixing her up!
I'm counting on you!
You? An honest day's work?
I've never seen it.
And you expect me to trust you?
Please, Julio! This was my idea.
Is there any chance you'll help us?
I'm sorry for imposing.
We'll be going now.
Me?! But Janus and Clau
are the ones who...
That's settled, then. Use the loan
as your starting capital.
Want to break your fingers, do you?
Want Julio to show you the steps?
Or will you get ready on your own?
